newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Meralco B rises 6.45 pct on technical rebound.
newsitem.headline: Meralco B rises 6.45 pct on technical rebound.

text.p: Manila Electric Co (Meralco) B shares rose by 12 pesos, or 6.45 percent, to 198 pesos by midsession on Thursday on a technical rebound, brokers said.
"It looks like it's a technical rebound as the issue reached a low of 173 pesos recently," said Bogart Cruz, trading manager at Asia Pacific Capital Equities & Securities Corp.
Cilette Liboro, research head at Citisecurities Inc, said that Meralco was not expected to post significant hike in its profits.
"The market may just be catering to (buying) issues that have been ignored and this includes Meralco," Liboro said.
